methods.name: Improved Faster R-CNN algorithm
methods.summary: An object detection algorithm for remote sensing images that replaces the VGG16 and ResNet50 feature extraction networks in the standard Faster R-CNN with DarkNet53. It incorporates skip connections to mitigate gradient vanishing and adds batch normalization and Leaky ReLU layers before the Region Proposal Network (RPN) to improve feature distribution and network nonlinearity.
